caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt with a light cream or off-white base color. The quilt features an intricate pattern consisting of interconnected blocks, bordered and segmented by a lattice of dark blue shapes that resemble four-petaled flowers or stars, each with a white pattern inside. Within each block, there are various quilted motifs, including clusters of round shapes, floral sprigs, leaves, and fruits, all rendered in subtle relief using contour lines to suggest texture and depth. In the central part of the quilt, the initials "S P" and the date "1826" are quilted in large, cursive script. The edges of the quilt are finished with a soft, textured fringe that further outlines its rectangular shape. The overall composition is orderly, with the repeating blue motifs forming a diagonal grid across the surface, framing each decorated block. The background of the drawing is a plain, light color, providing contrast to the quilt.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
